description: Hinopak Motors Limited was formed in 1986 by Hino Motors of Japan and Toyota Tsusho Corporation together with the Al-Futtaim Group of the UAE and PACO Pakistan; Hino Motors and Toyota Tsusho obtained majority shareholding in 1998 after the other two founding sponsors disinvested. It assembles and sells Hino commercial vehicles in Pakistan.
